newsitem.title: USA: In Home Health sees Q4 $0.06/shr charge.
newsitem.headline: In Home Health sees Q4 $0.06/shr charge.

text.p: In Home Health Inc said Thursday it reached an agreement under which two key officers, currently on administrative leave, would resign. The settlement will reduce fourth quarter earnings by $0.06 per share, the company said.
Resigning are Judy Figge, president and founder, and Ken Figge, chief financial officer.
In Home Health also said it repurchased 244,805 shares of stock held by the Figges, who also resigned as directors.
The company also said Cathy Reeves, chief operating officer, has resigned and her position will be eliminated.
Tom Gross was appointed acting chief financial officer, the company added. Gross, formerly vice president-controller, also retains that title.
A spokeswoman told Reuters the company has yet to decide whether it will fill the president's post.
